_doc: Copy to docs/qa/sites/<site-host>.json for each local QA site. Journeys never hardcode a host, login, slug or count: they use the placeholders below. Select a profile with QA_SITE=<site-host> (default: the host of base_url in qa-config.json). Pro journeys use the same profile (the pair shares one site).

owner.note: owns the fixture listings; same role as {other}

other.note: second member at the SAME role

unnamed.note: display name == login, so the public name is empty

nocap.note: a member whose submit/review capability is removed in the step that uses it

content.cat: slug of a category with published listings
content.loc: slug of a location with published listings (nested path ok: us/ny)
content.listing: slug of one published listing owned by {owner}
content.type_b: slug of a second listing type

notes: Anything about this site a tester must know (permalinks, mail catcher port, seeded counts).

pages._doc: Relative URLs of the mapped plugin pages. Read them, do not guess: wp eval with Page_Registry::get_id(<key>).
